verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents an Admin SDK Reports API that gives administrators programmatic access to domain audit and usage reports. It also offers login activity reports and an alerts API, so identity events are queryable through an API. Nothing in the evidence shows native streaming to a SIEM, a structured event schema, or bulk export, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: native SIEM streaming or export integration, a documented structured identity event schema, evidence that every identity event is covered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, every identity event is queryable and exportable — a structured system log with API access and native streaming to my SIEM

citations.quote: The Admin SDK Reports API lets administrators of enterprise domains to view the audit and usage reports of their domain.
View and manage Google Workspace alerts for your account.
